1. Revision history¶

1.1. Version 2.0¶

  • All HLL constructs are now declared within a namespace in order to prevent name collisions and shadowing warnings. You can configure the name of the namespace with Config.req_namespace. The DEVIATIONS namespace has been merged with the new namespace.
  • The DEVIATIONS_PRE namespace has been merged with the regular namespace for PRE variables.
  • Namespace paths are now always absolute.
  • The prefix of the requirements that should be exported is now configurable.

1.2. Version 1.1.1¶

  • Fixed inconsistent quoting of code variables.

1.3. Version 1.1¶

  • Handle Equivalence expression.
  • In exporting safety properties, do not abort on the same inputs, equations and functions shared by different GSS classes via class inheritance. Instead check they have the identical definitions and just keep one copy in the HLL export.
  • Collect the types in OM and make sure they are declared in Sorts.hll.

1.4. Version 1.0.2¶

  • The package is now Python 3 compatible

1.5. Version 1.0.1¶

  • Fixed a crash when translating “ALL” expressions.

1.6. Version 1.0¶

  • Initial version.
